rfeExplain.text: What this letter is and who sent itThis is a Request for Evidence (RFE) sent by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Potomac Service Center regarding Form I-765 for post-completion Optional Practical Training (OPT).Why you received itUSCIS is reviewing your application for employment authorization and has determined that the current evidence is not sufficient to establish your eligibility.What it asks forYou must submit the following items together with this notice:A copy of your Form I-20 endorsed by your Designated School Official (DSO) within the last 30 days, showing the post-completion OPT recommendation.A copy of your passport biographic page.Two passport-style photographs with your name and A NUMBER 1 written lightly on the back.A copy of your marriage certificate listing your spouse, NAME 2.DeadlineYour response must be received by December 17, 2026.What happens if you do nothingIf USCIS does not receive the requested evidence by the deadline, they will decide your application based on the existing record, and it may be denied.You should check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.
